# Turn the reference grid on and off

The Grid command is checkable and presentation-only. This page runs it with no window, shows the view request it returns, and reads the one switch every grid backend agrees on.

> **Generated page.** `tools/userdocs.py` writes it from
> [`tools/workflows/06_grid_visibility.py`](../../../tools/workflows/06_grid_visibility.py).
> Edit the workflow, not this page; `python3 tools/userdocs.py --check`
> fails when the two disagree.

**Requires:** the `FerroCAD` facade and `ferrocad_shell`; no GPU and no window.

## 1. Start from the default

`FerroCAD.Grid` is the semantic settings object for the reference grid. `enabled` is the switch a provider reads; it defaults to off.

```python
import json
import ferrocad_shell

FerroCAD.Grid.reset()
```

| Read back | Value |
| --- | --- |
| FerroCAD.Grid.enabled | false |

## 2. Run the command

`App_ToggleGrid` is registered by the shell and is checkable. It flips `FerroCAD.Grid.enabled` and returns a `view` request; the shell applies that request and mirrors the result into `FerroCADGui.ViewState`.

```python
first = json.loads(ferrocad_shell.run_command("App_ToggleGrid"))
```

| Read back | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Response | {"ok": true, "view": {"grid": true, "grid_alpha": 1.0, "grid_color": "#94a3b8", "grid_major": 100.0, "grid_minor": 10.0, "grid_radius": 0.0}} |
| FerroCAD.Grid.enabled | true |

## 3. Push the state the window would push

With no window, nothing has mirrored the request yet, so the check mark still reads the old state. `set_view_state` is the call the shell makes after it applies a request.

```python
ferrocad_shell.set_view_state(json.dumps(first["view"]))
checked = {
    c["id"]: c["checked"]
    for c in json.loads(ferrocad_shell.commands())
    if c["id"] == "App_ToggleGrid"
}
```

| Read back | Value |
| --- | --- |
| App_ToggleGrid checked | {"App_ToggleGrid": true} |
| FerroCADGui.ViewState.grid | true |

## 4. Turn it off again

```python
second = json.loads(ferrocad_shell.run_command("App_ToggleGrid"))
ferrocad_shell.set_view_state(json.dumps(second["view"]))
```

| Read back | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Response | {"ok": true, "view": {"grid": false, "grid_alpha": 1.0, "grid_color": "#94a3b8", "grid_major": 100.0, "grid_minor": 10.0, "grid_radius": 0.0}} |
| FerroCAD.Grid.enabled | false |

> Every grid backend reads this one switch. A provider that kept its own copy would keep drawing after the toggle, which is exactly the defect `docs/tasks/grid-visibility.md` fixed.
